title.narrative: International Counterproliferation Program (ICP): International Dual-Use Investigations

description.narrative: ICP delieved the International Dual-Use Investigation course mid- to senior-level officials from Polish National Police (PNP), ABW, Ministry of Finance (MoF) Customs Service (KAS), MoF Department for Combating Economic Crime, Border Guard, National Prosecutor's Office, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and Ministry of Development and Technology. The IDUI course included a combination of plenary lectures, breakout groups, and case studies. Participants demonstrated their understanding of multilateral export control regimes, specialized investigative techniques, and resources used in transnational investigations. The Polish law enforcement agencies maintain an advanced knowledge base in the areas of investigating crimes or incidents related to WMD. The Polish law enforcement agencies are working to address their counterproliferation awareness-level courseware development for inclusion in current police training programs.

title.narrative: Inter-European Air Forces Academy PME Mobile Course - Poland

description.narrative: This is a two-week course which provides an abbreviated version of the IESOS and IENCOA curriculum, with support from Polish speaking USAF instructors and cadre. It prepares NCOs and junior officers for more advanced leadership and management responsibilities. Students learn time and stress management, concepts of human behavior, teambuilding, critical thinking, effective communication, and leadership techniques, as well as implementing quality in the workplace. Experiential course activities challenge each student to apply curriculum concepts successfully and to influence group dynamics, cohesion, and effectiveness in a positive manner. By virtue of conducting portions of the course in the Polish language, IEAFA can reach a diverse group of officers and noncommissioned officers who are unable to access English-language processional development courses.
